instruction: Stream this Apple test video for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_ts/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple advanced example TS stream. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric to check URL. Same complexity as original streaming task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required aspects: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is being streamed
Metric function is_vlc_playing correctly handles the 'rule' parameter - uses direct access like rule['type'] and rule['url'], not incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules')
URL matching logic is comprehensive with multiple fallback methods suitable for HLS streams: direct match, filename extraction, domain/path comparison
Getter get_vlc_playing_info correctly retrieves VLC status XML via HTTP interface and returns the file path for metric evaluation
Edge cases properly handled: VLC not playing (returns 0), URL info not found in XML (returns 0), HLS streams showing only filename instead of full URL
No postconfig needed - VLC HTTP status interface is accessible while streaming
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts VLC status XML → Metric parses XML to check playing state and URL → Compares against expected URL from rules
